summary: Phase 1 (existPart_zero n>=2): proof logically complete, committed as WIP. Inline approach using Classical.em on compatible satisfiability with atom-by-atom Fin case analysis. LSP accepts but lake build has timeouts in simp_all and simp [Fin.ext_iff] for consistency extraction. Phase 2 (existPart_succ factoring) not started.

sorry_inventory.statement: existPart_zero n>=2 satisfiable case (inline proof, WIP)
sorry_inventory.assumption: n-var existential with constant base reduces to 2-var
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Proof logically complete (LSP-verified) but lake build fails with simp_all timeouts in the consistency extraction cases. Need to replace simp_all with explicit cases + absurd chains to avoid exponential simp blowup.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Fix 3 categories of build issues: (1) Replace simp_all with explicit cases on Bool values + absurd for base-base order extraction. (2) Replace simp [Fin.ext_iff] in nested cases with show + omega for Fin inequality proofs. (3) Add heartbeat limit increase or break into smaller lemmas with set_option maxHeartbeats.

sorry_inventory.assumption: Negation closure (Rabinovich Section 5) bridges base env mismatch
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Core mathematical blocker. Phase 2 factors into n=1 (sorry) and n>=2 (same reduction).
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Factor existPart_succ: cases n=1 (sorry) vs n>=2 (same 2-var reduction as existPart_zero).

blockers: existPart_zero n>=2: lake build timeouts in simp_all/simp[Fin.ext_iff] during consistency extraction

key_decisions: Helper lemma approach ABANDONED: Fin proof terms in lemma signatures cause omega failures under lake build but pass LSP. Root cause: omega cannot prove ¬(Fin.val ⟨0,_⟩ = Fin.val ⟨1,_⟩) when Fin types have variable bounds.
Inline proof approach ADOPTED: all consistency extraction and forward/backward proofs done inline within existPart_zero tactic block.
simp [Fin.ext_iff] replaces the pattern (by intro h; exact absurd (Fin.ext_iff.mp h) (by omega)) for Fin inequality proofs -- confirmed to work via lean_run_code.

Classical.em on COMPATIBLE satisfiability (nf_eval AND parent_atoms) rather than plain satisfiability -- this is mathematically necessary because a globally satisfiable sub_nf may be incompatible with specific parent_atoms.
Forward direction (n-var → 2-var) is purely projection, no consistency needed.
Backward direction (2-var → n-var) needs consistency: C1 (base preds agree with parent_atoms), C2 (base-base orders false), C3/C4 (x-base and base-x orders agree).
build_fix_hints: The simp_all timeouts occur in cases blocks where 4 Bool values are enumerated. Replace simp_all with targeted: rfl for matching cases, absurd (h.mp/mpr arg) (by simp [hsub]) for contradictory cases.
The simp [Fin.ext_iff] works for Fin inequality with numeric literals but may timeout when nested inside cases. Pre-compute the inequality proof as a have before the cases block.

The base-base order case (.order ⟨i+1,_⟩ ⟨j+1,_⟩) needs careful handling: extract from h_eval₀ that t₀ < t₀ is False, then show sub_nf must be false, then show the atom_eval at the current M is also False.
